d: Some careers shine brighter than others.
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential.

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as a Corporate Services Manager. The job holder is responsible for managing the day-to-day activities of the Corporate Services department at HSBC M Square Branch and as well as other corporate branches.
q: Strong knowledge of local and regional cash management with proven track record in Client Services.

Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to interact and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders

Excellent range of communication skills, including written, verbal, and the ability to deliver compelling presentations

r: Manage day-to-day corporate branch operations, ensuring effective organisation, efficient service delivery and robust control procedures.
Provide high-quality support to local and international clients on account operations, electronic channels, payments, cash management, trade services and other banking solutions.
Act as the key liaison between Client Service, regional and global stakeholders, product teams, operations and other internal functions.
Deliver client service excellence by managing service issues, resolving escalations and ensuring that client commitments are met.
Identify and implement process improvements that enhance the client experience, streamline operations, reduce duplication and strengthen relationships.
Support business growth through needs-based product referrals, cross-selling, client analysis and referrals to other HSBC business areas.

Maintain strong governance and risk management by completing operational checks, reviewing audit and regulatory recommendations, supporting information-security controls and ensuring fair customer outcomes.

d: Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Manager - Waste Operations to lead reliable, efficient and compliant waste collection services across Qiddiya City. This is an opportunity to combine hands-on operational leadership with a focus on recycling, service quality and a seamless visitor experience at a destination bringing entertainment, sports and culture together.
Lead daily operations: Plan collection routes, schedules, shifts and capacity around asset operating hours, waste volumes, access restrictions and peak events.
Manage contractor performance: Monitor delivery against agreed scopes, service-level agreements and KPIs, resolve service failures and drive corrective action.
Maintain service readiness: Oversee collection-point records, bin capacity and condition, vehicle and equipment availability, staffing and contingency arrangements.
Support recycling and segregation: Coordinate segregated collections and delivery to approved recycling, treatment or disposal facilities, maintaining the required operational documentation.
Coordinate across city teams: Establish clear collection interfaces, access arrangements and handovers, including readiness for new asset openings.
Respond to operational issues: Coordinate responses to missed collections, spills, equipment outages and waste accumulation through approved escalation procedures.
Drive efficiency and accountability: Track service completion, waste quantities, recycling recovery, complaints and cost per tonne; monitor expenditure and validate contractor invoices.
Champion safe, compliant delivery: Implement approved environmental and health and safety procedures, support team training and maintain auditable records.
q: A bachelor's degree in Environmental Management, Engineering, Operations Management or a related discipline, or an equivalent relevant professional qualification supported by substantial waste operations experience.
At least 8 years of relevant waste management or collection operations experience, including 3 years in a supervisory or management role overseeing service teams or contractors.

Hands-on experience managing multi-site waste collection, communal or central bin locations, contractors and receiving-facility interfaces within a city, municipality, large estate or mixed-use destination.
Strong capabilities in collection planning, route optimization, fleet and workforce coordination, contractor management and operational inspections.
Experience in service mobilisation, peak-demand planning, segregation and recycling, operational compliance, KPI reporting and cost control.
Clear communication, stakeholder coordination and data analysis skills, supported by knowledge of applicable waste and environmental requirements.

d: Product Regulatory Analyst – Financial Markets Venture

Goodman Masson is partnering with a new financial markets venture under formation in Oman. Backed by prominent institutional investors, the business is building its operations from the ground up and is now hiring during the build phase.

This is an opportunity to join at an early stage and help ensure that products, services and operating frameworks are aligned with applicable regulations, the company’s rule book and participant agreements.

The Product Regulatory Analyst will work closely with Product Development to review new and existing product features, identify regulatory gaps and recommend practical solutions before products or changes are launched.

The role will also support engagement with the regulator, including contributing to the development of regulations where the company’s services are not yet covered by an established framework. You will work collaboratively with product, legal, compliance, risk and operations teams to support strong regulatory governance as the business develops.
Review product features against applicable regulations, the company’s rule book and participant agreements.
Identify, document and assess compliance gaps, recommending practical remediation actions to product teams and management.
Support Product Development in working with the regulator to help draft regulations where existing frameworks do not yet cover the company’s services.
Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on current and planned products.
Maintain clear records of regulatory reviews, findings, recommendations and agreed actions to support audit and governance requirements.
Work with internal stakeholders to resolve regulatory matters and escalate material compliance gaps or risks appropriately.
Contribute to the development of robust regulatory processes and documentation as the venture grows.
q: A bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business, Economics or a related discipline.
Relevant experience in regulatory compliance, legal or product-related roles, ideally within financial services or payments.
A sound understanding of financial services regulation, rule books, participant agreements and product lifecycle processes.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret regulatory requirements and identify gaps or potential risks.
Excellent drafting, documentation and communication skills, with close attention to detail.
The ability to collaborate effectively with product teams and other stakeholders.
Fluency in written and spoken English.
Experience supporting regulatory engagement or contributing to regulatory or policy drafting.
A recognised qualification in compliance, regulation or risk management.
Experience working in a developing or evolving regulatory environment.
x: Based in Muscat, Oman. Permanent for Omani nationals; two-year fixed-term contract for expatriate hires. Omani nationals are strongly encouraged to apply.
If you have a sound understanding of financial services regulation, this is an opportunity to help build the operational foundations of a new financial markets venture. Please apply now!
